parts:
Hello, friends
 I have a question about building SEMm model by Lavven. My model includes one latent variable F which has 3 measure variables,such as x1,x2,x3. And there is another observalbe vairable D which also affect x1, i.e. x1=a*F+b*D. by the way, D is a dummy variable.So my question is how to build such a model by lavven ? 

  My answer is

my_model<- '  x_1 ~ D+f
          

          f =~ x_1+x_2+x_3
            
          f ~1 '

 fit <- sem(my_model,data=my_data)


but I don't think it is correct. Thanks

messages.author: 54c05e928c45ac6c
messages.subject: Re: How to build such a easy SEM model by lavaan pacakage? Thanks a lot
parts:
Usually you would think of F as causing the observed x variables, i.e. F is a reflective construct:

model <- '
F =~ x1 + x2 + x3
x1 ~ D
'
Note that f ~ 1 and x1 ~ 1 are not required unless you want to constrain the intercepts to a specific value. If you want to estimate the intercepts for the model simply use meanstructure = TRUE in sem(), but this will not affect the other model parameters unless it is constrained to a non-default value.
